label: Crowd up-share excess (z, live)
gloss: how far this coin’s up share sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or unanimous
